title: Financial Assistance Coordination: Assistance Reduction on Reference-Testing Estimates
content:
A patient's standing with the Patient Financial Assistance Program sets an assistance reduction on the reference-testing self-pay estimate for a Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Esoteric Reference Testing class.

**Clause.**

- When the patient holds an approved assistance case whose award start date is on or before the estimate date and whose award end date is on or after it, the estimate is reduced by that tier's discount percentage of the test price sum.
- When no approved award covers the estimate date and the patient has an assistance case *under review*, with no decision yet, the estimate is reduced by **10 percent** of the test price sum until the decision.
- A patient with neither takes no assistance reduction.

| Patient's assistance position on the estimate date | Estimate reduced by |
|---|---|
| An approved award covering the estimate date | that award tier's discount percentage of the test price sum |
| No approved award covering it, a case under review | 10 percent of the test price sum |
| Neither | nothing |

**Cases (hypothetical; the estimate is dated 20 August, test price sum of 400.00).**

1. An approved Financial Assistance 25% Discount award running 1 March to 31 August: reduced by 100.00.
2. An approved award that ended on 31 July, and a new application under review: reduced by 40.00.
3. An approved award that ended on 31 July and nothing under review: no assistance reduction.
